build_phi4_multimodal_causal_lm: build a Phi4MultimodalForCausalLM model for multimodal text generation with image and audio inputs
create_phi4_multimodal_vision_model: create a Phi4MultimodalVisionModel that processes image pixel values and returns pooled visual features
create_phi4_multimodal_audio_model: create a Phi4MultimodalAudioModel that encodes audio input features using conformer encoder layers
build_phi4_multimodal_feature_embedding: build a Phi4MultimodalFeatureEmbedding module that merges image and audio embeddings into text inputs
run_phi4_multimodal_generation: run Phi4MultimodalForCausalLM.generate() to produce text output conditioned on image and audio inputs
